about: SkinCheck knowledge base: how common ingredients affect each skin type. good = green, caution = yellow, avoid = red, missing = neutral (grey). General information, not medical advice.

ingredients.name: Glycerin
ingredients.why: Humectant: pulls water into the skin and keeps it hydrated.

ingredients.name: Hyaluronic acid
ingredients.why: Holds a lot of water: light hydration for every skin type.

ingredients.name: Niacinamide
ingredients.why: Vitamin B3: strengthens the skin barrier, evens skin tone and helps with oiliness and redness.

ingredients.name: Ceramides
ingredients.why: Lipids that the skin barrier is made of: repair dry and irritated skin.

ingredients.name: Cholesterol
ingredients.why: Part of the natural skin barrier, together with ceramides.

ingredients.name: Panthenol
ingredients.why: Pro-vitamin B5: hydrates and soothes.

ingredients.name: Allantoin
ingredients.why: Soothing and softening, very well tolerated.

ingredients.name: Bisabolol
ingredients.why: Calming ingredient from chamomile.

ingredients.name: Centella asiatica
ingredients.why: Plant extract that calms redness and supports skin repair.

ingredients.name: Aloe vera
ingredients.why: Hydrating and soothing.

ingredients.name: Green tea extract
ingredients.why: Antioxidant that also calms the skin.

ingredients.name: Betaine
ingredients.why: Gentle humectant that helps the skin keep water.

ingredients.name: Sodium PCA
ingredients.why: Part of the skin's own moisturizing factor.

ingredients.name: Urea
ingredients.why: Hydrates and softens rough, dry skin.

ingredients.name: Squalane
ingredients.why: Light oil similar to the skin's own sebum; does not clog pores.

ingredients.name: Vitamin E
ingredients.why: Antioxidant and moisturizing.

ingredients.name: Jojoba oil
ingredients.why: Plant wax-oil that nourishes without feeling heavy.

ingredients.name: Sunflower seed oil
ingredients.why: Rich in linoleic acid, supports the skin barrier.

ingredients.name: Shea butter
ingredients.why: Rich emollient: great for dry skin, can feel heavy on oily skin.

ingredients.name: Mineral oil
ingredients.why: Cosmetic-grade mineral oil is very gentle and locks in moisture.

ingredients.name: Dimethicone
ingredients.why: Silicone that stops water loss; does not clog pores for most people.

ingredients.name: Fatty alcohols
ingredients.why: Softening fatty alcohol. This is NOT the drying kind of alcohol.

ingredients.name: Coconut oil
ingredients.why: Nourishing, but can clog pores on oily or acne-prone skin.

ingredients.name: Isopropyl esters
ingredients.why: Emollients that can clog pores on acne-prone skin.

ingredients.name: Salicylic acid (BHA)
ingredients.why: Exfoliates inside the pores: helps with blackheads and oiliness, can dry out or sting.

ingredients.name: Glycolic acid (AHA)
ingredients.why: Exfoliates the surface for smoother skin; can sting sensitive skin. Use sunscreen.

ingredients.name: Lactic acid (AHA)
ingredients.why: Gentle exfoliant that also hydrates; can sting sensitive skin.

ingredients.name: Mandelic acid (AHA)
ingredients.why: Mild exfoliant with larger molecules, so it works more slowly and gently.

ingredients.name: Retinol
ingredients.why: Proven against wrinkles and acne; may cause dryness and irritation at the start.

ingredients.name: Bakuchiol
ingredients.why: Plant-based alternative to retinol, usually gentler.

ingredients.name: Vitamin C
ingredients.why: Antioxidant that brightens the skin; the pure acid form can sting sensitive skin.

ingredients.name: Vitamin C derivatives
ingredients.why: More stable and gentler forms of vitamin C.

ingredients.name: Zinc oxide
ingredients.why: Mineral UV filter, gentle and calming.

ingredients.name: Titanium dioxide
ingredients.why: Mineral UV filter and white pigment, very well tolerated.

ingredients.name: Clay
ingredients.why: Absorbs excess oil; can dry out skin that is already dry.

ingredients.name: Witch hazel
ingredients.why: Astringent with tannins; can be drying or irritating.

ingredients.name: Lanolin
ingredients.why: Very rich emollient, but a known contact allergen for some people.

ingredients.name: Drying alcohol
ingredients.why: Gives a light, quick-drying feel but dries out the skin and can damage the skin barrier.

ingredients.name: Fragrance
ingredients.why: The most common cause of allergic reactions to cosmetics; adds nothing for the skin.

ingredients.name: Fragrance allergens (EU list)
ingredients.why: Known allergen: EU law requires it to be named on the label.

ingredients.name: Essential oils
ingredients.why: Natural fragrance that contains several allergens; often irritates sensitive skin.

ingredients.name: Menthol / mint
ingredients.why: The cooling feeling is actually a mild irritation.

ingredients.name: Sodium lauryl sulfate
ingredients.why: Strong cleansing agent that strips the skin and is a classic irritant.

ingredients.name: Sodium laureth sulfate
ingredients.why: Gentler than SLS, but can still dry out the skin.

ingredients.name: Propylene glycol
ingredients.why: Usually fine, but it can irritate or cause allergies in a small number of people.

ingredients.name: Methylisothiazolinone
ingredients.why: Strong allergen: banned in leave-on products in the EU since 2017.

ingredients.name: Formaldehyde releasers
ingredients.why: Preservatives that slowly release formaldehyde, a known allergen.

ingredients.name: Lilial
ingredients.why: Fragrance banned in the EU since March 2022 (toxic for reproduction).

ingredients.name: Lyral (HICC)
ingredients.why: Strong fragrance allergen, banned in the EU since 2021.

ingredients.name: Banned parabens
ingredients.why: Banned in the EU since 2014 because their safety could not be shown.

ingredients.name: Parabens
ingredients.why: Preservatives. The EU safety committee considers them safe at the allowed amounts.

ingredients.name: Phenoxyethanol
ingredients.why: Common preservative, allowed in the EU up to 1%. Keeps the product free of bacteria.
